segments.name: Interactive displays
segments.description: Makes interactive displays, teaching and collaboration software for education, business and public sectors.
segments.evidence: Goodwill of $ 44,961 was allocated to this reporting unit, which is included in the Company's single reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Distributors and resellers pay for hardware and accessory products, plus extended warranties and training services.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate the majority of our revenue from the sales of hardware and accessory products to a global network of distributors and resellers, who are considered the customers for these products.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company sold Global Eduhub Holding, its early childcare learning business in Singapore, and reported it as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: This sale represented a strategic shift with a major effect on our operations and financial results, and as a result, the GEH Singapore segment has been presented as discontinued operations and excluded from both continuing operations and segment results for the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2023.

changes.text: In 2023, the Company transferred its entire education business in China and ceased operating it.
changes.evidence: As a result of the foregoing transactions, we ceased operations of all education business in China and NetDragon, through ND BVI, holds approximately 73% of our outstanding ordinary shares as of December 31, 2025.
